adjudication.rationale: The diff adds new behavior in `Post#cook` to immediately `return raw` when `cook_method == Post.cook_methods[:raw_html]`, which bypasses both `post_analyzer.cook(*args)` and `Plugin::Filter.apply(:after_post_cook, ...)` (app/models/post.rb). The added/updated specs only cover that an imported TopicEmbed post ends up with `cook_method == :raw_html` and `post.cooked == post.raw` (spec/models/topic_embed_spec.rb), but do not verify (a) that plugin filters are skipped for raw_html posts, or (b) that non-raw_html posts still go through the normal cooking + plugin filter pipeline. This is a concrete missing-test gap for newly introduced nontrivial branching logic, not a proven runtime defect.
